caption: The nested boxes place L = {00, 01, 10, 11} inside L* (all even lengths) inside Σ*. The string 0000 shows L* has length 4, while odd strings like 010 lie outside L*.

spec.aria: Nested boxes labelled sigma-star, L-star and L; L holds the four length-two strings, L-star adds even-length strings such as epsilon and 0000, and sigma-star adds odd strings such as 010 and 111.
